_comment: R32 for A2: one single-edit mutant per invariant tests/a claims, each with the case names that must catch it on an assertion. Run with `node tests/a/run-mutants.mjs`. The real-PG cases (grant-pg.test.ts) need a database and are not in this list; the DB rules they exercise are A1's own mutants (tests/d/signup_mutants.py).

mutants.note: the grant is claimed for an id taken from the URL instead of the verified session
cases: A2-CB-03 a verified callback claims the grant ONCE, for the server-verified user, never an id from the URL

mutants.note: a verified callback never claims the grant (RV-06)
cases: A2-CB-03 a verified callback claims the grant ONCE, for the server-verified user, never an id from the URL
A2-CB-04 the token-hash form verifies the OTP with its type, then claims

mutants.note: a failed claim blocks sign-in instead of landing on onboarding's retry
cases: A2-CB-06 a claim that fails or throws does not block sign-in: the user lands on onboarding to retry

mutants.note: the provider's free-text error_description is reflected into the login page
mutants.find: return authFailure({ code: params.get("error_code") }) === "link_expired" ? LINK_EXPIRED : LINK_INVALID;
cases: A2-CB-01 a link error is a fixed code; the provider's description is never reflected into the page

mutants.note: a failed or expired exchange still proceeds to claim and sign in
cases: A2-CB-05 an expired or reused code is the expired-link state and claims nothing

mutants.note: a callback whose session cannot be read still claims
cases: A2-CB-07 a session that cannot be read after the exchange is an invalid link and claims nothing

mutants.note: a backslash (`/\\evil`, which a browser reads as `//evil`) is accepted in a same-site redirect
cases: A2-NEXT-01 safeNext refuses protocol-relative, backslash and absolute targets
A2-CB-08 recovery goes to set-a-new-password; a safe next is kept and an unsafe one is dropped

mutants.note: a replayed grant is announced as a new one
cases: A2-GRANT-01 granted and replayed are both credited, with the exact amount; only the first is `first`

mutants.note: a non-canonical amount ("10000") is shown as credited
cases: A2-GRANT-03 an error, no row, an unknown status or an inexact amount is unavailable, never a guessed credit

mutants.note: a claim error with a stale row is read as the row
cases: A2-GRANT-03 an error, no row, an unknown status or an inexact amount is unavailable, never a guessed credit

mutants.note: a held grant (identity reuse, rollout hold, retired) is reported as a transient outage
cases: A2-GRANT-02 every denial is its own state; none of them is credited

mutants.note: the onboarding action claims with no session user
cases: A2-GRANT-04 the onboarding action claims for the session user only; no session claims nothing

mutants.note: no wallet is shown as a confirmed zero balance
mutants.replace: if (row.wallet_id === null) return { kind: "available", available: parseCredit("0.00000000"), grantedAt: null };
cases: A2-BAL-02 no wallet yet is `not_issued`, stated explicitly, never shown as a confirmed zero balance

mutants.note: a USD figure is displayed as the CREDIT balance
cases: A2-BAL-03 a failed, empty, wrong-unit or inexact read is unavailable, never a zero or a float

mutants.note: a JSON number is accepted as an exact balance
cases: A2-BAL-03 a failed, empty, wrong-unit or inexact read is unavailable, never a zero or a float

mutants.note: an unknown address reads differently from a wrong password
cases: A2-ENUM-01 wrong password and unknown address read identically

mutants.note: signing up with a registered address says so
cases: A2-ENUM-02 signing up with an address that already has an account looks exactly like a new signup

mutants.note: a bare 429 is reported as a generic outage instead of a rate limit
cases: A2-ENUM-03 rate limits, expired links and outages are actionable codes; the raw server message never is the copy

mutants.note: the login page shows whatever text ?error= carries
mutants.find: return typeof code === "string" && Object.hasOwn(NOTICES, code) ? NOTICES[code] : null;
cases: A2-NOTICE-01 the login page shows only known notices; anything else in ?error= is ignored

mutants.note: a client component imports the service-role grant port directly
cases: A2-BUNDLE-01 no client component reaches the service-role client, however indirectly

mutants.note: the callback route wires a claim that never reaches the grant
cases: A2-CB-09 the callback route delegates to the tested flow and claims through the grant port

mutants.note: an auth page shows the raw server error text
cases: A2-COPY-02 no auth page makes a retention, ZDR or 120-second claim, or prechecks a data-use permission

mutants.note: an error region is not announced to assistive technology
cases: A2-A11Y-01 every auth input has a label, and every error region is announced
